spans.s: vājapeya (EI 22; CII 4; BL), name of a Vedic sacrifice.
Vāji-vaidya (BL), explained as ‘a veterinary physician’; literally, ‘a physician for horses’.

vajra (HA), thunderbolt.
 Cf. vaccira-ppaḍai (SITI), the lower or foundation tier of the wall of a temple.
vajrāsana (LL), name of the seat on which the Buddha sat for meditation for the attainment of supreme knowledge (bodhi).
